**Echo Entry – Narrative Fragment**  
Deep in the tidal battery fields, engineer Soren waded across saltwater tiles shimmering like dragon scales. At dusk, the sea withdrew, exposing copper pillars crusted with barnacles. As the first star appeared, faint blue halos sparked around each anode—electrons hurrying shoreward through brine. Soren touched a pillar; a soft vibration greeted his palm, like distant applause. He realized the ocean wasn’t merely feeding energy to the grid—it was applauding the chance to finish each wave with purpose.
